description: This script automates the process of fetching sponsors data from GitHub's GraphQL API, processes and saves it in a YAML file, and then pushes the changes via git to create a pull request. It is a self-contained, executable Python script with functions to perform API queries, handle responses, update files, and orchestrate git operations.

classes.name: SponsorEntity
classes.description: Represents a sponsor entity which could be a user or organization with login, avatar URL, and profile URL.

classes.name: Tier
classes.description: Represents the sponsorship tier with a name and monthly price.

classes.name: SponsorshipAsMaintainerNode
classes.description: Links a sponsor entity with a specific sponsorship tier.

classes.name: SponsorshipAsMaintainerEdge
classes.description: Contains the cursor and node for each sponsorship edge.

classes.name: SponsorshipAsMaintainer
classes.description: Wraps a list of edges representing sponsorships.

classes.name: SponsorsUser
classes.description: Represents a user with sponsorships as maintainer.

classes.name: SponsorsResponseData
classes.description: Structure for API response data containing user information.

classes.name: SponsorsResponse
classes.description: Top-level response structure for the sponsors GraphQL API.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Configuration class holding tokens, repository info, and timeout settings.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] get_graphql_response( *, settings: Settings, query: str, after: str | None = None, )
methods.description: Performs a POST request to the GitHub GraphQL API, handling errors and returning JSON data.

methods.name: list[SponsorshipAsMaintainerEdge] get_graphql_sponsor_edges( *, settings: Settings, after: str | None = None )
methods.description: Fetches sponsor edges data from the API, returning list of sponsorship edge objects.

methods.name: defaultdict[float,dict[str,SponsorEntity]] get_individual_sponsors( settings: Settings, )
methods.description: Aggregates sponsor nodes grouped by their monthly contribution tiers.

methods.name: bool update_content(*, content_path: Path, new_content: Any)
methods.description: Reads a file, compares with new content, and updates if different, returning whether an update occurred.

methods.name: None main()
methods.description: Main script execution: orchestrates fetching sponsorship data, updating local YAML, and creating a PR on GitHub.
